snippet.title: The Well Is Not Empty - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for The Well Is Not Empty, a stylized first-person psychological horror game developed by tweakEra. Players will explore a dark, abandoned underground structure beneath a village that's been deprived of water. Investigate the occurrence, find hidden secrets, and survive at all costs. The Well Is Not Empty is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
